findings.why: Even in the creator's voice, 'No white cast' is an absolute promise for a sunscreen that won't hold for every skin tone and amount applied. The scoped form is acceptable.
findings.fix: No visible white cast on my skin

tone_read: This is a creator ad in the creator's own voice, so brand tone rules don't apply; it is warm and personal, with no fear hook or hype words. The emoji are the creator's style.
language_read: Disclosure is clear and upfront ('This is PR' early in the caption, plus #ad). The only claim to tighten is the unscoped 'No white cast'; 'lightweight, and reliable' is personal and low-risk.
